title: Cursor/AI IDE
content: Apply Cursor aesthetic with AI IDE feel. Code editor with AI panels. Inline code suggestions. Chat interface for AI. Diff views for AI changes. Terminal integration. File explorer. AI-generated documentation. Command palette. Multi-file editing. Version control integration.

variants.simple: Create AI-powered development environment with inline assistance and code generation.
variants.detailed: Apply Cursor aesthetic with AI IDE feel. Code editor with AI panels. Inline code suggestions. Chat interface for AI. Diff views for AI changes. Terminal integration. File explorer. AI-generated documentation. Command palette. Multi-file editing. Version control integration.
variants.advanced: Apply Cursor aesthetic with AI IDE patterns. Editor: Monaco or CodeMirror base, multiple tabs, syntax highlighting. AI inline: ghost text suggestions (grayed italic), Tab to accept, partial accept. AI panel: side panel or bottom panel chat interface, context-aware. Chat: markdown rendering, code blocks with copy and apply. Diffs: AI changes as diff view, accept/reject buttons per line or file. Apply changes: preview before apply, undo stack. Context: @file, @folder, @symbol mentions, auto-include relevant code. Commands: Cmd+K for inline edit prompt, Cmd+L for chat focus. Generation: loading state with progress, streaming text appearance. Prompts: saved prompts, prompt history, edit and rerun. Terminal: integrated terminal, AI can suggest commands. Files: tree explorer with search, file status indicators. Git: gutter indicators, inline blame, commit from IDE. Multi-file: AI can edit across files, show all changes before apply. Diagnostics: error squiggles, AI fix suggestions. Documentation: generate docs from selection, inline docstrings. Refactoring: AI-powered rename, extract function. Search: semantic search, find usages. Settings: AI model selection, behavior toggles, API keys. Themes: dark, light, high contrast. Collaboration: share session, pair programming. Extensions: plugin system for additional AI features.

author: Ersin KOÇ
